# Owner Creation via REST — Research Report

This is the **Spring PetClinic REST** sample. The REST API layer is **OpenAPI-generated**: controllers implement generated `*Api` interfaces, and request/response objects (`OwnerDto`, `OwnerFieldsDto`, etc.) are generated DTOs (not on disk — produced by the openapi-generator-maven-plugin into `target/generated-sources/openapi/`). MapStruct maps DTOs <-> JPA entities.

## 1. Owner entity (model)
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`
- `@Entity @Table(name = "owners")`, extends `Person`.
- Fields with Bean Validation:
  - `address` — `@NotEmpty`
  - `city` — `@NotEmpty`
  - `telephone` — `@NotEmpty @Digits(fraction=0, integer=10) @Pattern(regexp="^[0-9]{10}$", message="Phone number must be exactly 10 digits")`
  - `pets` — `@OneToMany(... mappedBy="owner", EAGER)`

`firstName` / `lastName` live on the parent:
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Person.java`
- `firstName` — `@NotEmpty` (`@Column(name="first_name")`)
- `lastName` — `@NotEmpty` (`@Column(name="last_name")`)
- `Person extends BaseEntity` (BaseEntity holds `id` / `isNew()`).

## 2. REST controller — POST create endpoint
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`
- `@RestController @RequestMapping("/api")`, implements generated `OwnersApi`. This is the endpoint the tests hit (`POST /api/owners`).
- The create method:
```java
@PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")
@Override
public ResponseEntity<OwnerDto> addOwner(OwnerFieldsDto ownerFieldsDto) {
    HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
    Owner owner = ownerMapper.toOwner(ownerFieldsDto);
    this.clinicService.saveOwner(owner);
    OwnerDto ownerDto = ownerMapper.toOwnerDto(owner);
    headers.setLocation(UriComponentsBuilder.newInstance()
        .path("/api/owners/{id}").buildAndExpand(owner.getId()).toUri());
    return new ResponseEntity<>(ownerDto, headers, HttpStatus.CREATED);
}
```
Same file also has `getOwner`, `listOwners`, `updateOwner`, `deleteOwner`, `addPetToOwner`, etc. There is a V2 controller `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v2/OwnerRestControllerV2.java` but it is **read/paging only** (no create).

Service layer: `ClinicService.saveOwner(Owner)` / `findOwnerById(int)` at `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/ClinicService.java`.

## 3. Validation / DTOs / request body
- Request body DTO: **`OwnerFieldsDto`** (generated). Response DTO: **`OwnerDto`** (generated). Package `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto`.
- Schemas defined in the OpenAPI spec: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`
  - `addOwner` operation at line 65 (`POST /owners`, requestBody `$ref OwnerFields`, 201 -> `Owner`, 400/500 -> `ProblemDetail`).
  - `OwnerFields` schema (line 1991): properties `firstName, lastName, address, city, telephone`, all in `required`; each has `minLength/maxLength` and some `pattern` constraints (e.g. firstName pattern `^[\p{L}]+([ '-][\p{L}]+){0,2}$`, telephone `^[0-9]*$`, maxLength 20).
  - `Owner` schema (line 2040): `allOf` OwnerFields + readOnly `id` and `pets`.
- MapStruct mapper: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java` — `toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)` ignores `id` and `pets`; also `toOwnerDto`, collection/page mappers.
- Validation is enforced by Bean Validation on the generated interface parameters (the entity itself also carries `@NotEmpty` etc.).

## 4. Error / exception handling (`@ControllerAdvice`) — IMPORTANT GAP
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/advice/ExceptionControllerAdvice.java` (`@ControllerAdvice`)
- `handleMethodArgumentNotValidException(MethodArgumentNotValidException)` -> **400**, builds an RFC-7807 `ProblemDetail` and sets property **`schemaValidationErrors`** (a list of `ValidationMessageDto`, each with `field`, `rejectedValue`, `defaultMessage`).
- Also handles `AccessDeniedException` (re-throws), generic `Exception` -> 500, `DataIntegrityViolationException` -> 404.
- Helper `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/BindingErrorsResponse.java` builds a JSON array of `{objectName, fieldName, fieldValue, errorMessage}` via `toJSON()` — but the advice only calls `addAllErrors` and does **not** put this under an `errors` key.

**Key finding:** There is currently **no JSON body containing an `errors` array** anywhere in `src/main/java` (grep for `"errors"` returns nothing). The error body uses `schemaValidationErrors`, not `errors`. The acceptance test (below) expects `$.errors` to be a JSON array containing the offending field name (`"city"`), so producing an `errors` array is exactly what an implementation change here needs to add.

## 5. Existing tests for owner creation
Only three test files exist, all under `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/`:
- `AcceptanceTest.java` — the owner-creation acceptance tests:
  - `errorRejectsMissingCity` — removes `city`, expects `status().isBadRequest()` **and** `jsonPath("$.errors").value(hasItem("city"))`.
  - `errorRejectsBlankTelephone` — telephone `"   "`, expects 400.
  - `functionalityAcceptsCompleteOwner` — valid owner, expects 2xx.
- `AcceptanceBase.java` — `@SpringBootTest @AutoConfigureMockMvc @Transactional @WithMockUser(roles={"OWNER_ADMIN","VET_ADMIN","ADMIN"})`. Provides `createOwner(...)`/`createOwnerOk(...)` (POST `/api/owners`), `ownerNode()` (valid unique payload: firstName, lastName, address, city, telephone), `getOwner`/`fetchOwner`, and helpers. Uses the Jackson 3 `tools.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper`.
- `AuditLogCapture.java` — utility to assert on the `AUDIT` logback logger.

No unit test exists yet for `OwnerRestControllerV1` itself; the acceptance suite is black-box over `POST /api/owners` + `GET /api/owners/{id}`.

## 6. Build tool & running tests
- **Maven** (`/home/daniel/sandbox/pom.xml`, wrapper `/home/daniel/sandbox/mvnw`). No Gradle.
- OpenAPI codegen: `openapi-generator-maven-plugin` 7.23.0, `generatorName=spring`, `interfaceOnly`, `apiPackage=...rest.api`, `modelPackage=...rest.dto`, input `src/main/resources/openapi.yml`, output `target/generated-sources/openapi/src/main/java`. MapStruct runs in annotation processing. So changing request/response shape means editing `openapi.yml` and regenerating, or hand-editing the entity/mapper/advice.
- Run all tests: `cd /home/daniel/sandbox && ./mvnw test`
- Run just the acceptance test: `./mvnw test -Dtest=AcceptanceTest`
- Note: `test` triggers the generate step, so the build must regenerate DTOs/APIs before compiling.

### Bottom line for an implementer
The endpoint (`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`) and validated model already exist. The visible gap the tests target is the **error response shape**: `AcceptanceTest.errorRejectsMissingCity` requires the 400 body to include a top-level JSON **`errors`** array listing rejected field names (e.g. `"city"`), which `ExceptionControllerAdvice.handleMethodArgumentNotValidException` does **not** currently emit (it emits `schemaValidationErrors`). That advice class (plus possibly `BindingErrorsResponse`) is where a change would go.
